ios.desc:
PhilosophMe is a calm, reflective space to explore your beliefs, understand your thinking patterns, and engage with the ideas that shape human thought.

Unlike personality quizzes or political tests, PhilosophMe is not about right answers or labels. It’s a guided journey into your own mind.

*What You’ll Do*

-Explore Five Philosophical Domains: Ethics, Politics, Meaning, Knowledge, and Self.

-Reflect Deeply: Thoughtful questions and daily prompts let you pause, write, or consider your stance.

-Build Your Belief Map: Visualize your tendencies and the tensions in your thinking without judgment or oversimplification.

-Discover Philosophers & Ideas: See which thinkers resonate with your profile, and access a curated library of essays and reflections.

-Return & Revisit: Keep track of reflections over time; your philosophical profile evolves as you do.

*Why PhilosophMe is Different*

-Reflection-first design: Slows down the experience, encouraging meaningful engagement.

-Nuanced insights: Highlights internal tensions instead of forcing labels.

-Context-aware library: Essays and thoughts relate directly to your profile, showing relevance without prescriptive advice.

-Privacy-first: All reflections and profiles are stored locally; no accounts required.

*Features*

-Guided self-assessment across five domains, with 7-point nuanced responses.

-Personal belief map with interpretable axes and confidence indicators.

-Narrative summaries, domain interpretations, and philosophical tensions.

-Daily reflection prompts with flexible engagement: write, select, or sit with ideas.

-Curated library of essays, thoughts, and prompts tied to your profile.

-Reflection archive to revisit insights over time.

-Resumable and retakable self-assessment.

PhilosophMe is perfect for curious, introspective users who want to step away from fast quizzes and social comparisons, and spend time understanding how they think.

**PhilosophMe isn’t a test — it’s a conversation with your own mind.**

show_hn.title: Show HN: PhilosophMe – a minimal iOS app for daily philosophical thinking

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built a small iOS app called PhilosophMe. It has a philosophy quantifier, then, it delivers one short philosophical prompt per day — designed to encourage reflection rather than productivity or motivation.

I noticed most “thinking” apps either oversimplify philosophy into quotes or gamify it heavily. This is intentionally slow and minimal.

I’m especially interested in feedback on:
• Whether the value proposition is clear
• If this feels like something you’d actually open daily
• Whether philosophy apps even make sense on mobile
• What to do w/onboarding

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/philosophme/id6758975792
